title: Business English Conversation 45:  Meeting a New Colleague
content: 1. Nice to meet you.: a polite sentence used when meeting a person for the first time A) Hello. My name is Nick. B) Hello Nick. I'm James. Nice to meet you. A) Hello. I'm Sally. B) Nice to meet you Sally. I'm Dan. 2. Please let me know if...: Please tell me if... - Please let me know if the schedule changes. - Please let me know if you can come. 3. Here is my business card.: a sentence used when giving a person one's business card - Here is my business card. Call me if you have any questions. A) Here is my business card. B) Thank you. Here is mine.
